purpose: Freeze the scientific and provenance semantics required before any prospective <=90-day 2x formation can receive an authoritative final outcome or enter factory metrics.

core_observation_limit.fact: The integrated trusted outcome substrate stores authenticated point-in-time spot samples. A point sample at or above target can prove that the sampled market was at or above target at that observation, but point samples cannot prove that no between-sample target crossing occurred and cannot by themselves identify the true first crossing time.
core_observation_limit.consequence: Point-sample coverage alone may support non-final positive breach evidence, but it must never produce authoritative EXPIRED/no-hit, exact first-hit time, complete max/min path, or competing-risk timing claims.
core_observation_limit.forbidden_shortcut: Do not convert dense snapshots into gapless path coverage merely by choosing a small sampling cadence.

authoritative_path_evidence.required_origin: Append-only DB/provider-authenticated evidence bound to the exact trusted formation, canonical asset, exact venue/instrument, provider/source identity, raw/provider-native evidence digest, observed interval/event time, availability/capture time, and server-created durable membership.
allowed_path_evidence: provider-native trade/event sequence with immutable event identity and event timestamp
provider-native interval aggregates whose high/low semantics cover the complete stated interval and whose retained bytes/receipt are independently verifiable
not_sufficient: locally recomputed hashes without durable DB membership
point snapshots used to infer absence of an intrainterval crossing
present-day reconstructed history without PIT/source-authentic provenance
authoritative_path_evidence.boundary_rule: No aggregate interval may straddle formation or expiry and be treated as complete post-formation/pre-expiry evidence unless trusted constituent events or an authenticated provider representation proves the exact in-scope sub-interval. Otherwise the affected boundary is censored.

requirements: Every authoritative path record for the resolution window is included exactly once.
The final resolution fingerprint commits formation receipt identity plus the complete ordered evidence-set digest.
Removing, replacing, reordering, cross-asset transplanting, or cross-venue/instrument transplanting any member invalidates the final receipt.
Caller-selected subsets never receive authoritative final-resolution status.

threshold_events.reference_price: Exact trusted frozen formation reference price.

thresholds.PLUS_100: frozen formation target price; minimum 2.00x reference price

first_crossing_semantics.trade_level: An exact event timestamp may be recorded only when authenticated ordered provider events establish the first crossing after formation within the authoritative covered path.
first_crossing_semantics.interval_level: If only interval high/low evidence exists, crossing time is interval-censored. Record crossing_lower_bound and crossing_upper_bound; never fabricate an exact timestamp.
first_crossing_semantics.no_crossing: Absence of a crossing is authoritative only across complete trusted interval/event coverage.

required: authoritative trusted path evidence contains a +100%/frozen-target crossing after formation and on/before expiry
crossing identity/time or censoring interval is derived deterministically from the complete ordered evidence set
formation and complete evidence-set fingerprints verify
trusted path coverage is complete from strictly after formation through the trusted expiry boundary
no covered provider event/interval high reaches the frozen target
no unresolved coverage gap, provider outage, identity ambiguity, or boundary-straddling ambiguity exists
formation froze a structured machine-verifiable invalidation rule identifier and parameters before outcome observation
trusted evidence satisfying that exact rule contract exists
invalidation event ordering versus threshold events is deterministically resolved
INVALIDATED.forbidden: Free-text invalidation prose alone has zero authoritative invalidation power.

ILLIQUID_OR_DELISTED.required: Explicit timestamp-safe provider/venue/listing or microstructure evidence proving the predeclared competing-risk event. Missing prices/quotes alone are insufficient.
ILLIQUID_OR_DELISTED.model_role: Competing risk / censoring state; never silently recoded as an ordinary non-winner.

CENSORED_GAP_NOT_EXPIRED.required: Any material path-coverage gap, unverified boundary interval, provider disagreement that the frozen contract requires to resolve, or missing authoritative evidence.
CENSORED_GAP_NOT_EXPIRED.model_role: Censored/incomplete observation. Excluded from ordinary EXPIRED negatives.

path_statistics.observed_max: Derived only from complete trusted path aggregates/events; point-sample maximum is labeled sampled_max and is not promoted to authoritative path maximum.
path_statistics.observed_min: Derived only from complete trusted path aggregates/events; point-sample minimum is labeled sampled_min and is not promoted to authoritative path minimum.
path_statistics.drawdown: When complete high/low/event coverage exists, derive deterministically under a separately versioned rule. Otherwise drawdown is UNKNOWN/CENSORED rather than inferred from sparse snapshots.

allowed_only_when: all included outcomes use authoritative final receipts under this or a later reviewed contract
interval-censored crossing times remain interval-censored in the model rather than collapsed to fabricated point times
right-censoring and illiquidity/delisting competing risks are retained explicitly
PIT/tradability/matched-control and multiple-testing gates remain satisfied
primary_metrics: calibrated competing-risk/time-to-event diagnostics only when adequately powered

mandatory_red_green_tests_for_implementa: point samples below target throughout horizon cannot produce EXPIRED without complete interval/event coverage
a target crossing that occurs between sparse point samples is not falsely classified as no-hit
a bar/aggregate that straddles formation cannot backfill a pre-formation high as a post-formation HIT
a bar/aggregate that straddles expiry cannot extend the trusted horizon without exact sub-interval proof
trade-level first crossing can produce an exact event time only when event ordering is authenticated
bar-level first crossing produces an interval-censored time rather than an invented exact timestamp
one omitted/reordered/replaced durable evidence member invalidates the final resolution fingerprint
cross-asset and cross-venue/instrument evidence transplantation is rejected
free-text invalidation cannot produce authoritative INVALIDATED
explicit delisting/illiquidity evidence is preserved as a competing risk rather than ordinary expiry
exact replay of the complete authoritative evidence set is idempotent
implementation_sequence: 1. Add a trusted interval/event evidence acquisition contract; do not reuse point snapshots as no-hit proof.
2. Persist append-only authoritative path members with exact formation/asset/venue/provider binding.
3. Add DB-owned complete-path enumeration and deterministic evidence-set fingerprinting.
4. Add a final-resolution RPC/store that derives states and threshold timing from the complete authoritative path only.
5. Add Python independent receipt verification and adversarial tests.
6. Run exact-head Security & Reliability plus independent adversarial review; then runtime-test the migration against a safe non-prediction fixture before granting metrics authority.

prospective_policy.candidate_counting: No candidate or outcome count is implied by this contract.
prospective_policy.existing_formations: Existing trusted formations may accumulate non-final provider evidence, but no final performance result is admitted until this contract is implemented, reviewed, deployed and independently verified.
